  PROBLEM: In seed_blocked(), `events = gh.label_events(issue.number)` (line 622) replaced a comment-position check that made no API call with a paginated REST `issues/<n>/events` read. The result is never stored and the "deliberately moved back" branch returns "" with no log line, so every open `ai:blocked` issue that carries a seed marker repeats the read on every poll tick.
  WHY: Each such issue among the 50 blocked candidates costs 1-10 REST calls per tick with no end condition. That is the per-item call inside a polling loop that §14 forbids, and no per-issue line in the `op=scan` summary explains it. All reviewers rated it MAJOR. openai_gpt-6-luna also cites `scan()` lines 712-720 and the agents fragment line 7 in this finding.
- agents.d/stuck-states-p8b-dependency-wait-resume.md:7 | severity=low | confidence=5

  WHY: The documented API-call contract no longer matches the helper, so anyone estimating rate-limit cost from the fragment will miss the per-tick events read. All three reviewers rated it NIT. openai_gpt-6-luna also cites this line inside its MAJOR performance finding above. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised it only as a hardening suggestion, at "fragment line 10".
- scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:625-630 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The seed_blocked() generator `((event.get("actor") or {}).get("login"))` / `((event.get("label") or {}).get("name"))` assumes any truthy actor/label is a dict, unlike clear_latch(), which guards with `isinstance(actor, dict)`.
  WHY: A malformed, non-dict payload raises AttributeError. It escapes into scan() and main()'s outer except, which aborts the whole tick for every remaining issue. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 rated it MAJOR and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT, so the higher rating is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised the same point as a hardening suggestion.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:326 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The PR adds a `scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py` inventory row in docs/INVENTORY.md, which is not in issue #8859's `files_touched` grant.
  WHY: The pre-push scope check rejects the out-of-grant change, which causes the `tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py` failure on every push. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash notes the row is needed by `tests/inventory_parity.py`, so the fix is a grant amendment.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:seed_blocked(), line 622 `events = gh.label_events(issue.number)`, and the `return ""` that follows (lines 625-632) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A paginated REST `issues/<n>/events` read replaced the comment-position check, which made no API call. It runs on every tick for each open `ai:blocked` issue that has a trusted `"source":"seed"` marker for the same `Depends on: #N`, has no resume marker, and lacks `ai:needs-human`. The result is never stored and nothing is logged.
  WHY: Issues moved back to `ai:blocked`, either silently or by following the escalation instructions, cost 1-10 REST calls per tick with no end condition, the pattern §14 forbids. Suggested fix: call label_events only when the seed marker is the newest trusted comment (`found[0] == max index of _trusted(...)`).
- agents.d/stuck-states-p8b-dependency-wait-resume.md:line 7, "Call budget" bullet | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The bullet still reads "...one events read only when clearing a latch." The docstring "Conditional reads" section and the "Label lifecycle" bullet were updated for the new read at scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:622, but this bullet was not.
  WHY: The documented API-call contract no longer matches the helper, so rate-limit estimates miss the events read on seeded blocked issues.
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE. Label registration and the plan.yml `/answer` gate belong to confine-plan Phase 4a and are deferred. The docs/INVENTORY.md row was accepted as residual in earlier rounds and is not re-flagged.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py seed_blocked(), the any() generator at lines 625-630
  PROBLEM: `((event.get("actor") or {}).get("login"))` assumes a truthy actor/label is a dict, so a non-dict raises AttributeError. main() catches it, which ends the whole tick.
  WHY: Fix by adding `isinstance(..., dict)` checks as clear_latch() does (3-4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  PROBLEM: The docstring "Conditional reads" section was updated for the new seed-recovery events read but the fragment bullet was not, so it contradicts `gh.label_events(issue.number)` in `seed_blocked()` (scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:622).
  WHY: Rate-limit estimates miss the per-tick events read, now 1-10 REST calls per such issue per tick instead of zero. The fragment is the documented contract for downstream workflows.
- scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:seed_blocked(), lines 625-630 — `((event.get("actor") or {}).get("login"))` and `((event.get("label") or {}).get("name"))` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A truthy non-dict actor/label skips the `or {}` fallback and then crashes on `.get`. clear_latch() guards with `isinstance(actor, dict)`.
  WHY: A malformed payload raises AttributeError, and main()'s outer `except Exception` catches it and aborts the whole tick, losing every other waiting/seeding decision.
- scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:seed_blocked(), line 622 — `events = gh.label_events(issue.number)` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Nothing is cached or recorded for "deliberately moved back", so the read repeats every tick for each re-blocked seeded issue. The cost is hidden because the branch returns an empty string.
  WHY: Up to 50 blocked issues per tick, each re-blocked one costing a paginated `issues/<n>/events` call, replaces the free comment-position check with an unbounded per-tick REST cost that does not show in `op=scan waiting=… seeded=… api_calls=…`. §14 requires a documented gate for recurring per-item calls in a polling loop.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Requirement: Implementation is limited to the files listed in the pipeline plan grant for issue #8859 (`files_touched` under `<!-- ai:pipeline-plan-grant:v1 -->`). The pre-push gate fails `tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py` for an out-of-grant file.
  Expected change site: Either `docs/INVENTORY.md` line 326 (remove the added `scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py` row) or the issue comment / grant that names the additional file the implementation needs to touch.
  Evidence of absence: `docs/INVENTORY.md:326` is in `pr_changed_files.txt` but not in the grant's `files_touched` list. The row was kept to satisfy `tests/inventory_parity.py`, so one of the two tests will keep failing until the grant is updated or the row is removed.
